schema.help: Count only stops on the way there, not on the way back.
schema.text: Do you plan to stop somewhere on the way? (e.g. a shop or a café)

ar.#Count only stops on the way there, not: احسب التوقفات في طريق الذهاب فقط، لا في طريق العودة.
ar.#Do you plan to stop somewhere on the wa: هل من المخطط التوقف في مكان ما في الطريق؟ (مثل متجر أو مقهى)

de.#Count only stops on the way there, not: Zählen Sie nur Stopps auf dem Hinweg, nicht auf dem Rückweg.
de.#Do you plan to stop somewhere on the wa: Planen Sie unterwegs einen Zwischenstopp? (z. B. ein Geschäft oder ein Café)

en.#Count only stops on the way there, not: Count only stops on the way there, not on the way back.
en.#Do you plan to stop somewhere on the wa: Do you plan to stop somewhere on the way? (e.g. a shop or a café)

fa.#Count only stops on the way there, not: فقط توقف‌های مسیر رفت را حساب کنید، نه برگشت.
fa.#Do you plan to stop somewhere on the wa: آیا قصد دارید در مسیر جایی توقف کنید؟ (مثلاً یک مغازه یا کافه)

fr.#Count only stops on the way there, not: Comptez seulement les arrêts à l’aller, pas au retour.
fr.#Do you plan to stop somewhere on the wa: Prévoyez-vous de vous arrêter quelque part en chemin ? (par ex. un magasin ou un café)

hu.#Count only stops on the way there, not: Csak az odaúton tett megállásokat számolja, a visszautat nem.
hu.#Do you plan to stop somewhere on the wa: Tervez útközben megállni valahol? (pl. egy boltban vagy kávézóban)

it.#Count only stops on the way there, not: Conta solo le soste all'andata, non al ritorno.
it.#Do you plan to stop somewhere on the wa: Pensi di fare delle soste lungo il tragitto? (ad es. un negozio o un bar)

tr.#Count only stops on the way there, not: Yalnızca gidiş yolundaki duraklamaları sayın, dönüşü değil.
tr.#Do you plan to stop somewhere on the wa: Yolda bir yerde durmayı planlıyor musunuz? (ör. bir dükkân veya kafe)
